text.en:
While above 50% Magazine:
Direct Hits create a Stasis burst which applies 50 Slow for <pve 4 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds to enemies within [?] meters.

Only activates once per shot.
(Wolfpack Rounds can activate is a second time)

<title Whisper of Durance [Whisper of Durance] /> increases slow duration by <pve 8 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Stability.
)
text.zh-chs:
前半弹匣直接命中敌人时：
将产生一个冰影爆炸，附近 [?] 米内的敌人获得 50 层减速效果。持续 <pve 4 /> <pvp [1.5] /> 秒。

每次射击仅触发一次效果。
（狼群弹药可触发多次。）

<title 耐久之吟 [Whisper of Durance] /> 可将持续时间增加到 <pve 8 /> <pvp [2] /> 秒。

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 稳定性。
)
